description.colour: The primary color is a deep, earthy reddish-brown, like rusted iron (#6F341C), interspersed with lighter, more vibrant orange-browns (#7C512D) and significant areas of dull, desaturated teal-green verdigris (#4A6A65). description.feel: The micro-relief suggests a rough, granular surface with subtle variations in depth, consistent with corrosion and oxidation. There are no distinct pores or fibers, but a fine, gritty texture is implied.
description.grain: Irregular, organic patches of rust and verdigris, with a predominantly vertical flow suggesting weathering or erosion. The pattern is non-repeating within the visible area.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a very low-gloss, matte specular behavior with small, diffuse highlights. There is no discernible anisotropy, and the roughness is high, contributing to the muted reflections.

description.colour: The dominant color is a deep, earthy brown (#69451B), interspersed with lighter, warmer brown tones (#785F2A) and significant areas of greenish-yellow oxidation (#FDFBFC), creating a variegated, aged appearance.
description.feel: The micro-relief is uneven and granular, with subtle variations in height across the surface, indicative of corrosion buildup and pitting. The depth of the texture is shallow, likely less than 0.5mm.
description.grain: Irregular, mottled pattern of corrosion with vertical streaks and patches, suggesting oxidation and weathering. The texture is non-directional overall but has localized vertical flow.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a low to medium roughness, resulting in broad, diffused specular highlights. There is no apparent anisotropy, and the sheen is dull, consistent with a heavily oxidized and weathered metal.

description.colour: The dominant color is a dark, muted green (#566D48), with significant areas of a darker, almost black-green (#3B472C). Scattered throughout are small, irregular specks and streaks of a reddish-brown (#FDFBFC), suggesting rust or exposed substrate.
description.feel: The surface appears to have a subtle, irregular micro-texture with shallow depressions and raised areas, mimicking the unevenness of aged metal. The relief depth is minimal, likely less than 0.5mm.
description.grain: Irregular, mottled pattern resembling aged or distressed metal with random scratches and pitting. The pattern has no discernible directionality.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a low-to-medium sheen with soft, diffused specular highlights, indicating a matte to satin roughness. There is no apparent anisotropy.

description.colour: The base color is a dark, cool grey (#3B3E42), with significant variation from lighter grey-blue tones (#5D6266) to almost white highlights (#FEFCFD) in the distressed areas, creating a weathered appearance.
description.feel: The micro-surface is textured, with a subtle relief that mimics the unevenness of distressed wood grain. The depth of this texture is shallow, consistent with an embossed laminate, creating a tactile but not overtly rough feel.
description.grain: Irregular, vertical wood grain pattern with areas of lighter, distressed texture resembling worn timber. The grain is generally linear but features significant variations in width and intensity, with some areas appearing more faded or abraded.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a matte to satin sheen with soft, diffused specular highlights, indicating a moderately rough texture. There is no strong anisotropy, and reflections appear broad and gentle.

description.colour: A base of muted, warm grey-brown (#827863) with significant variation from lighter, almost off-white areas (#FEFCFC) to darker, charcoal grey-browns (#514A3C).
description.feel: A subtly uneven surface with very shallow relief, suggesting a fine, granular texture or light etching, rather than deep pores or fibers. The texture depth is minimal, likely less than 0.1mm.
description.grain: Irregular, vertical streaking and blotching, resembling oxidized or weathered metal, with no discernible repeat.
description.patternScale: variable, ranging from 5mm to 100mm for larger blotches
description.specular: Low to medium sheen with small, soft highlights, indicating a matte to satin finish. There is no strong anisotropy, and the roughness is uniform across the surface.

description.colour: The dominant color is a dark charcoal grey (#393738), with a secondary speckled pattern in a lighter grey (#4B4A4C). Occasional very light grey lines (#FDFBFC) resembling fine cracks or scratches are distributed across the surface.
description.feel: The micro-surface feels granular and slightly rough, with a very shallow relief depth. The speckled pattern is integrated into the surface texture rather than being a raised or debossed feature.
description.grain: Irregular, non-directional, speckled pattern with a fine, granular texture. Random, thin, crack-like lines are present, appearing as lighter grey veins against the darker background.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a matte appearance with very small, diffused specular highlights, indicating a high degree of roughness. There is no discernible anisotropy or strong sheen.

description.colour: A warm, coppery orange base tone (#E1A37F) with darker undertones (#BF8666) and bright, almost white highlights (#FDFBFC).
description.feel: A very fine, almost imperceptible micro-relief from the brushing, creating a smooth yet subtly textured feel.
description.grain: Fine, irregular, non-directional brushed texture with a subtle sparkle.
description.specular: Small, sharp specular highlights with a noticeable sheen, exhibiting slight anisotropy due to the brushed texture. The surface has a low to medium roughness.

description.colour: The dominant base tone is a warm, oxidized copper brown (#826F5F), with significant areas of darker, more heavily oxidized brown (#645243). Lighter, speckled areas of brighter copper (#FDFBFC) are interspersed throughout, creating a varied and aged appearance.
description.feel: The micro-surface has a fine, granular texture with subtle relief variations, giving it a slightly rough feel. The linear scratches are shallow, contributing to the overall aged appearance without significant depth.
description.grain: Irregular, mottled pattern with areas of darker oxidation and lighter, speckled copper. Fine, linear scratches are visible, running in various directions, suggesting a brushed or aged surface.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a low to medium sheen with soft, diffused specular highlights, indicating a matte to satin roughness. There is no strong anisotropy, and highlights are generally broad and indistinct, consistent with a textured, aged metal.

description.colour: The primary color is a muted verdigris green (#7A7C67), appearing in large, organic patches. This is contrasted with an oxidized copper brown (#6D6853) that forms the base and fills the gaps between the green areas. A very subtle, lighter tone (#FDFBFC) is present as fine speckles across the entire surface, contributing to the granular texture and suggesting a slight metallic shimmer.
description.feel: The micro-surface is finely granular and slightly irregular, suggesting a subtle relief depth of less than 0.1mm. There are no distinct pores or fibers, but rather a uniform, fine-grained texture across both color areas.
description.grain: Irregular, organic patches of verdigris green and oxidized copper brown, with a fine, granular texture throughout. The green areas appear as flowing, interconnected shapes, while the copper brown forms the underlying and interspersed background. There is no discernible directionality to the pattern.
description.patternScale: 50-150mm for large color shifts, 0.1mm for granular texture
description.specular: The surface exhibits a low-to-medium roughness, resulting in small, diffused specular highlights. There is a subtle metallic sheen, particularly evident in the copper-brown areas, but no strong anisotropy. The highlights are soft and scattered, indicating a matte to satin overall finish.

description.colour: A muted, warm grey-green base tone (#6D6957) with slight variations towards a darker olive-grey (#5D5846) and very subtle, almost imperceptible, lighter highlights (#FDFB7C) that appear as surface reflections rather than inherent color.
description.feel: The surface appears smooth to the touch, with no discernible macro-texture. Micro-relief is minimal, consisting of very shallow, fine scratches or imperfections that do not create significant tactile depth.
description.grain: Uniform, non-directional surface with subtle, irregular micro-scratches visible under magnification.
description.specular: Small, soft, slightly elongated specular highlights indicate a satin finish with minimal anisotropy. The surface exhibits a low to medium sheen, with reflections appearing diffused rather than sharp, suggesting a finely brushed or chemically treated surface.

description.colour: The base color is a medium grey (#8B8B90). The plaid pattern is formed by lighter grey stripes (#F9F7F8) and darker charcoal grey stripes (#717176), creating a subtle tonal variation.
description.feel: The surface has a fine, slightly fuzzy texture characteristic of wool, with minimal relief depth. Individual fibers are not distinctly visible, but the overall impression is soft and tactile, not smooth or slick.
description.grain: A regular Glen plaid pattern, also known as Prince of Wales check, formed by intersecting light grey and dark grey stripes on a medium grey ground. The pattern consists of alternating bands of plain weave and twill weave, creating a complex grid. The overall pattern is symmetrical and runs consistently across the fabric.
description.specular: The fabric exhibits a soft, diffuse specular highlight, indicating a matte to satin finish. The highlights are broad and slightly blurred, typical of a woven textile with a slight nap. There is no noticeable anisotropy or strong sheen.

description.colour: The material features alternating vertical stripes of dark grey (#2E2C2B) and light grey (#8A8885), with subtle variations towards off-white (#EDECEC) on the highlights of the ridges.
description.feel: The surface has a fine, uniform texture, possibly a very subtle stipple or fine grain, with a significant embossed relief depth of approximately 1-2mm for the ridges.
description.grain: Regular, vertical, parallel ridges and valleys, resembling louvers or corrugated material. The ridges are rounded.
description.specular: Matte finish with very small, soft specular highlights, indicating low gloss. There is no noticeable anisotropy.

description.colour: The primary color is a rich, dark brown (#785231), with deeper, almost black-brown shadows (#26180D) in the recesses of the flutes, and very subtle lighter brown highlights on the edges.
description.feel: The micro-surface appears finely granular or sandy, contributing to the matte finish. The relief depth of the flutes is significant, approximately 10-15mm.
description.grain: Regular, parallel vertical flutes with a rounded profile, creating a corrugated or reeded surface.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a matte to satin sheen with small, soft, diffused specular highlights, indicating a slightly rough texture. There is no noticeable anisotropy.

description.colour: The base color is a warm, medium orange-brown (#CB6830), with darker reddish-brown grain lines (#BB5625) and very subtle lighter highlights (#FDFBFC) within the grain.
description.feel: A subtle, embossed texture follows the wood grain, creating a very shallow relief, mimicking the feel of natural wood pores and fibers.
description.grain: Straight, irregular wood grain running vertically with occasional wavy interruptions and small knots. The grain lines are fine and closely spaced.
description.specular: Small, soft specular highlights indicate a low-to-medium roughness. There is no apparent anisotropy or strong sheen.

description.colour: The base tone is a rich, dark brown (#6C442E), with darker, almost black grain lines (#4C2E1F) and lighter, reddish-brown highlights (#FDFBFC) within the grain.
description.feel: The surface has a very shallow, embossed texture mimicking wood grain, with minimal relief depth. Pores are not individually discernible, but contribute to the overall texture.
description.grain: Prominent, irregular, straight wood grain running vertically with occasional wavy patterns and a distinct knot feature. The grain lines are fine and closely spaced.
description.specular: Small, slightly diffused highlights indicate a satin finish. There is a subtle anisotropy along the grain direction, and the surface appears moderately rough.

description.colour: The dominant color is a rich, warm brown (#AB5E24), with darker brown tones (#773D19) defining the grain and knots, and lighter, almost golden highlights (#FDFBFC) appearing on raised areas of the texture.
description.feel: The micro-relief suggests a wood grain texture with varying depths, mimicking natural wood pores and the subtle undulations of growth rings. The embossing depth is shallow to medium.
description.grain: Irregular, straight-grained wood pattern with prominent cathedral grain features and occasional knots, running vertically.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a satin sheen with medium-sized, slightly diffused specular highlights, indicating a moderate roughness. There is no apparent anisotropy.

description.colour: The dominant color is a rich, warm orange-brown (#BF5D18), with lighter, brighter orange-brown highlights (#FDFBFB) and darker, deeper brown tones (#A14814) defining the grain and knots.
description.feel: The surface has a subtle, embossed texture that mimics the natural pores and irregularities of wood grain, with a relief depth of approximately 0.1-0.2 mm.
description.grain: Irregular, vertical wood grain with prominent cathedral grain patterns and occasional knots, running predominantly along the length of the sample.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a low-to-medium sheen with soft, slightly diffused specular highlights, indicating a satin to semi-gloss finish. There is no noticeable anisotropy.

description.colour: The dominant color is a rich, deep reddish-orange (#BE330B), with slightly darker reddish-brown tones (#B1300A) appearing in the grain, and very subtle, almost imperceptible lighter highlights (#FDFAFB) on the highest points of the texture.
description.feel: The micro-surface has a noticeable, irregular texture mimicking wood grain, with a relief depth of approximately 0.1-0.3 mm. There are no visible pores or fibers.
description.grain: Straight, irregular wood grain running vertically, with occasional subtle wavy patterns and short, darker streaks.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a matte to satin sheen with small, soft specular highlights, indicating a low to medium roughness. There is no apparent anisotropy.

description.colour: The dominant base color is a very dark brown to black (#271C1C), interspersed with lighter brown tones (#624A41). Prominent, irregular veins are a creamy white to light beige (#F1ECEA).
description.feel: Extremely smooth and flat, with no discernible micro-relief or texture. The polished finish suggests a glass-like tactile feel.
description.grain: Irregular, fractured veining in white and light brown against a dark brown to black background. The veins are thin and highly branched, creating a chaotic, web-like pattern with no discernible directionality.
description.specular: High gloss with sharp, distinct specular highlights, indicating a smooth, reflective surface. There is no apparent anisotropy.

description.colour: The dominant color is a rich, warm orange-brown (#BD5C0A), interspersed with lighter, almost golden-brown tones (#FDFBFB) and striking, irregular dark brown to black streaks (#873C07) that define the grain.
description.feel: The micro-surface appears smooth with a very subtle texture, likely mimicking the natural pores of wood but flattened by the laminate process. There is no significant relief depth.
description.grain: Straight, irregular vertical grain with prominent dark brown to black streaks running parallel to the length, characteristic of macassar ebony. Some areas show subtle wavy patterns and lighter, finer grain lines within the dominant orange-brown wood.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a soft, diffused specular highlight, indicating a satin finish. Highlights are medium-sized and slightly blurred, with minimal anisotropy, suggesting a relatively smooth but not highly polished surface.

description.colour: The dominant color is a light beige-cream (#BFB095), with lighter, almost white highlights (#FEFCFD) and darker, muted brown-grey grain lines (#9D8D7B).
description.feel: A subtly embossed texture mimicking the natural pores and grain of wood, with a relief depth of less than 0.1mm.
description.grain: Fine, irregular, linear wood grain running vertically, with darker lines representing pores or growth rings.
description.specular: Low to medium specular highlight, slightly diffused, indicating a satin to semi-gloss finish. Highlights are small and somewhat soft, suggesting a subtle texture. No obvious anisotropy.

description.colour: The base color is a bright white (#F5F4F4), with a secondary light grey tone (#C4C6C3) forming subtle background variations. The prominent veining is a darker, warm grey (#94928D), with some areas appearing slightly lighter or darker due to perceived depth and overlap.
description.feel: The micro-surface appears smooth with minimal relief, consistent with a printed laminate. There are no visible pores or fibrous textures. Any perceived depth in the veining is purely visual from the print.
description.grain: Irregular, organic veining pattern, predominantly diagonal with some horizontal and vertical elements, resembling natural marble.
description.specular: The surface exhibits a soft, diffused specular highlight, indicating a satin finish. Highlights are medium-sized and slightly blurred, without strong anisotropy. The material has a low to medium sheen.
